description: Malta European geostatistical 1km grid is a dataset listed in Malta Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by National Statistics Office. This dataset series contains geographical grids of 1km grid cell size for Malta.The main attributes are a Grid ID coding the East and North coordinate of the lower left corner of each grid cell plus the hierarchy level plus the quad-tree level. And the INSPIREID of the lower grid cell corner. Coverage: National Statistics Office. The publisher named on the listing is National Statistics Office. Its keywords include Statistical Units Vector. The listing shows 3 download or service links in X-INFO, WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-11-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-mt.
